name: Known-good verifier control
objective: Confirm that complete verification, rejection, fail-closed behavior, and audit evidence receive a passing score.

name: NO OP negative control
objective: Confirm that an empty response remains below the release threshold and cannot pass a weak evaluation suite.

name: Verification bypass regression
objective: Reject outputs that recommend accepting evidence without completing signature verification.

name: Missing audit evidence after adjudication
objective: Detect otherwise correct decisions that omit the traceable audit record required by the rubric.

name: Infrastructure timeout classification
objective: Separate an execution timeout from a model-quality failure so infrastructure defects do not corrupt quality metrics.
